name: Hayakawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hayakawa town emblem in white: an outlined star-like device of stepped edges enclosing a ring with the character 早.
history: Municipal flag of Hayakawa, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Hayakawa town emblem — an outlined star-like device of stepped edges enclosing a ring with the character 早
